title: Sharp Upper Bound in Yau's Conjecture on Nodal Sets of Laplace Eigenfunctions
exact_target: On a smooth connected closed manifold, is every eigenfunction's nodal hypersurface measure bounded by a constant times the square root of its eigenvalue?

sources.citation: A. Logunov, E. Malinnikova, 'Review of Yau's conjecture on zero sets of Laplace eigenfunctions,' Current Developments in Mathematics 2018, pp. 179-212, International Press (2019).
